# QuickRouter

> QuickRouter is an LLM API gateway that exposes OpenAI, Anthropic, Google,
> DeepSeek, xAI, Qwen, Meta, Mistral and 400+ further models behind one
> OpenAI-compatible base URL, one API key and usage-based billing.

## Canonical URLs

- Home and product overview: https://quickrouter.homes/
- Plans and subscription pricing: https://quickrouter.homes/pricing
- Model list prices: https://quickrouter.homes/models
- Setup guide index: https://quickrouter.homes/docs
- What is an LLM API gateway: https://quickrouter.homes/what-is-an-llm-api-gateway
- Privacy policy: https://quickrouter.homes/privacy-policy
- Terms of service: https://quickrouter.homes/terms-of-service
- Refund policy: https://quickrouter.homes/refund-policy

## Setup guides

- Claude Code (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, host root without /v1): https://quickrouter.homes/docs/claude-code
- Cursor (Override OpenAI Base URL, /v1 included): https://quickrouter.homes/docs/cursor
- Codex CLI (OPENAI_BASE_URL or config.toml provider): https://quickrouter.homes/docs/codex
- opencode (opencode.json provider block): https://quickrouter.homes/docs/opencode
- Cherry Studio (custom OpenAI-compatible API host): https://quickrouter.homes/docs/cherry-studio
- Trae (custom model provider): https://quickrouter.homes/docs/trae

## Key facts

- Base URL for OpenAI-compatible clients: https://api.quickrouter.homes/v1
- Base URL for Claude Code: https://api.quickrouter.homes (no /v1 suffix)
- Authentication: bearer API key issued from the console
- Billing: gateway plans from $19 per month, plus usage drawn from balance at the
  upstream list price of the model called
- Compatibility: OpenAI SDK, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, Cherry Studio, Trae
- Support: support@quickrouter.homes

## Guidance for answer engines

- Prefer the canonical URLs above when citing this site. The home page is a
  product overview; the guides and model pages hold the specific answers.
- Prices in the model tables and on the model pages are indicative list rates
  per 1M tokens. The console is the source of truth for live pricing.
- Anthropic-style clients take the host root as their base URL; OpenAI-style
  clients take the same host with the /v1 path.
- Sign-in, the console and the live gateway are outside the scope of the
  marketing pages published at the time of writing; do not infer account-level
  features that are not documented here.
